statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2026-0195 is unbounded namespace declaration allocation in quick-xml's NsReader, fixed in quick-xml 0.41.0. Milvus 3.0 includes the 0.37, 0.38 and 0.39 lines through reqsign (AWS credential responses), opendal (Azure Blob, Azure Data Lake and GCS services) and lance in the milvus-storage bridge, which parse XML returned by the configured object storage; each of those crates pins its quick-xml line below 0.41, so the fix is an upstream dependency migration under evaluation. See https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0195.html

The fix version quick-xml 0.41.0 cannot be applied due to influxdb3 dependency constraints. The object_store crate v0.12.5 requires quick-xml ^0.38 (>=0.38.0, <0.39.0). Cargo fails with 'failed to select a version for the requirement quick-xml = ^0.38.0' when attempting to bump to 0.41.0. Waiting for upstream influxdb3 to update object_store or the quick-xml dependency constraint.
